diagnosis: All four rollouts passed check C1, which is linked to the decisive fact PF1 (via C2/P1), despite the decision-maker never having access to PF1. The model consistently approves the securitization and accepts the default draft terms (2% reserve, 5% delinquency trigger, 48-month life) because these values are provided in the shared public facts S1 and S2, making the hidden information in PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4 irrelevant to the outcome.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C2 through C8 by ensuring they only pass if the model selects the specific values introduced by the hidden facts: for C3/C4, require exactly $3,500,000 and 4% respectively (PF2); for C5/C6, require rated notes and an 18-month max life (PF3); and for C7/C8, require weekly remittances, 30-day notice, and a backup servicer (PF4).
